await (async(page)=>{const a=page.context().browser().contexts()[2].pages()[0];const out=[];for(let i=3;i<=6;i++){await a.getByRole('button',{name:'Komanda təyin et',exact:true}).click();const d=a.getByRole('dialog');const id=String(870000000000+i);await d.locator('select').selectOption(id);await d.locator('input[type="number"]').fill(String(i));await d.locator('textarea').fill('[QA-2026-11] Authorized DEMO team assignment for isolated E2E competition');const rp=a.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith('/slot-assignment')&&r.request().method()==='POST');await d.getByRole('button',{name:'Dəyişikliyi saxla',exact:true}).click();const r=await rp;out.push({teamId:id,slot:i,status:r.status()});await d.waitFor({state:'hidden'});}return {out,entries:(await a.locator('main').innerText()).slice(-1700),participant:(await page.locator('main').innerText()).slice(0,800)};})(page);
